title: HR Administrator
company: ACS Recruitment Solutions Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
HR ADMINISTRATOR

Northampton Up to £30,000 Monday-Friday, 8:30am-5:30pm Permanent

An exciting opportunity has become available for an experienced HR Administrator to join a well-established and globally recognised business in Northampton.

Working as part of a supportive HR team, this role will play an important part in keeping the employee lifecycle, HR systems and day-to-day people processes running smoothly.

What will you be doing?
- Supporting the full employee lifecycle, from recruitment and onboarding through to leavers
- Maintaining accurate and confidential employee records and HR systems
- Preparing contracts, offer letters and HR documentation
- Coordinating right-to-work checks and new starter paperwork
- Supporting the monthly payroll process
- Managing HR inbox queries and supporting employees and managers
- Maintaining absence, holiday and training records
- Producing HR reports and supporting HR projects and audits
- Helping identify opportunities to improve HR processes

What are they looking for?

The ideal candidate will have:

-Previous experience in HR Administration, HR Assistant or a similar role
-Excellent organisation and attention to detail
-Confidence handling confidential and sensitive information
-Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook
-Strong communication and people skills
-The ability to juggle multiple priorities in a busy environment
-Experience using HR systems would be advantageous
-CIPD Level 3 or working towards it would be a bonus

What's on offer?

-Up to £30,000 per annum
-25 days annual leave + 8 bank holidays
-Free on-site parking
-Company pension
-Life Assurance
-Employee Assistance Programme
-Employee discounts
-Cycle to Work scheme
-Training and development opportunities
-Long service awards & referral rewards

Interested? Apply today to discuss confidentially with Gabriella Saunders at ACS Staffing Solutions!

title: HR Administrator
company: ENB Recruitment and Training Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
HR Administrator

Northampton

£30k per annum

Monday-Friday 08:30-17:30

ENB are supporting a client in Northampton who are looking for a HR Administrator to join their HR team on a full time, permanent basis. Within this role, you will provide HR administration support to the wider HR team, ensuring employee records, HR processes, and people related documentation are maintained to a high standard while delivering an excellent service to managers and employees across the business.

Day to day you will:
- Support with administrative duties across the full employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, employment changes and leavers.
- Maintain employee records and HR systems, ensuring all information is accurate, up-to-date, and compliant with GDPR requirements.
- Prepare employment contracts, offer letters, amendments, and other HR documentation in a timely manner.
- Coordinate the onboarding process for new starters, ensuring all required documentation and right-to-work checks are completed.
- Support the payroll process by collating and submitting employee data, including starters, leavers, and contractual changes.
- Manage HR inbox enquiries, responding to routine queries and escalating where appropriate.
- Monitor and maintain absence records, annual leave records, and other employee data.
- Assist with the administration of learning and development activities, maintaining training records and booking courses where required.

What experience will you need?
- Prior experience in an HR Administration or HR Assistant
- A CIPD Level 3 qualification (or currently working towards) would be advantageous.
- Strong administrative and organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Experience maintaining confidential employee information and handling sensitive data appropriately.
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
- Excellent communication skills and the ability to build positive working relationships at all levels.
- The ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritise workload effectively in a busy environment.
- A proactive and flexible approach, with a willingness to support the wider HR team.
- An understanding of HR processes and employment legislation would be beneficial.

title: Sales Administrator
description:
Sales Administrator

Northampton 27,000 - 29,000 DOE Temporary to Permanent

Are you an experienced Sales Administrator looking for a role where you can take ownership, work closely with customers and become a valued part of a growing business?

We're working with an established manufacturing business based in Northampton to recruit a Sales Administrator into a brand-new position created due to continued growth.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys the commercial side of administration - speaking to customers, supporting sales activity, keeping things organised and making sure opportunities don't get missed.

You'll work closely with the sales team, supporting the day-to-day sales operation while also having the opportunity to get involved in areas such as reporting, customer analysis and some general business administration.

There is a small amount of finance administration within the role, including supporting with invoices and purchase orders, but the main focus is Sales Administration and customer support.

Why is this a great opportunity?

This is much more than a traditional sales admin position.

The role has been created from scratch, meaning you'll have the opportunity to put your own stamp on it, improve processes and take ownership rather than simply following the same routine every day.

The business is well established but continues to grow, offering the successful candidate the chance to develop alongside the company and build a long-term career.

You'll be joining a small, friendly team where people work closely together and everyone has an important part to play. If you're someone who likes being busy, getting involved and seeing the impact of your work, this could be a really good fit.

Who are they looking for?

We're looking for someone with previous experience in Sales Administration, Sales Support, Customer Service Administration or a similar commercial role.

You'll ideally be:
- Confident dealing with customers over the phone and email.
- Experienced in supporting a sales team and managing customer enquiries.
- Comfortable preparing quotations, processing orders and keeping customer information up to date.
- Confident using Sage - this is essential.
- Organised and able to manage multiple priorities.
- Naturally proactive - someone who sees what needs doing and gets on with it.
- Commercially minded, with an interest in customers and sales.
- Confident working with spreadsheets, data and reports.
- Happy to get involved with some basic finance administration when required.

You do not need to be an accounts professional. We're primarily looking for a strong Sales Administrator with Sage experience, a confident telephone manner and the right attitude.

What's on offer?

This is a temporary-to-permanent opportunity, initially joining on a temporary basis for approximately 3 months, with the intention of moving into a permanent position following a successful placement and mutual suitability.

Once permanent, you'll receive:
- 28 days' annual leave.
- Paid Christmas shutdown, in addition to your holiday allowance.
- Private healthcare.
- Long-term career development opportunities.
- The chance to help shape a brand-new position.
- A varied role with genuine responsibility and scope to develop.
- A supportive, close-knit working environment.
- The opportunity to build a long-term career within an established and growing manufacturing business.

The person we're looking for

If you're a good Sales Administrator who enjoys speaking to customers, supporting sales and being proactive, we'd like to hear from you.

We're not looking for someone who needs to tick every box. More importantly, we're looking for someone with the right attitude, commercial mindset and willingness to get involved.

If you're looking for your next move and want a role where you can make an impact, develop your skills and grow with a business, this could be the opportunity for you.

Apply today or contact Impact Recruitment for more information.
